thread:
Elaine: Heads-up — we have a small pile of docs PRs that need reviewers + CI preview checks before we can merge. TL;DR: snippets, migration guide, and a couple link fixes. Can folks volunteer?

Mike: I can take SDK snippets and the Swift/TS examples. Prefer to do those today. :raised_hands:

Sam: I can do the migration guide but I'm oncall until Thu afternoon — won't be super fast. Ping me if it's urgent.

Elaine: Thanks! Mike, snippets are in #4321 and #4330. Sam, migration guide is #4310 (big one with platform changes). Also one small PR (#4342) is just link fixes and a redirect update.

Lisa: Quick question — do we want docs reviewers to also check the docs preview build (Netlify/CI) before approving? My vote: yes for any content change that touches code samples or redirects.

Mike: yes I'll run the preview for the snippets. CI preview URL is in the PR checks but sometimes it times out; if preview fails, leave a comment and set "needs-preview" label.

Tariq: I can pick up the link fixes (#4342) and do the preview smoke test. Also happy to be primary reviewer for small changes this week.

Elaine: Awesome — assigning: Mike -> #4321,#4330 (SDK snippets); Sam -> #4310 (migration guide, slower turnaround); Tariq -> #4342 (link fixes). Lisa will do a second pass on the migration guide once Sam gives a thumbs-up.

Sam: Sounds good. Note on #4310: there are several code fences that need updated CLI flags and one example that relies on old API names. I'll leave inline comments and push a tiny follow-up commit.

Mike: FYI for reviewers: run this locally if examples fail in preview:
```
npm run docs:preview
gh pr checkout <pr-number> && npm run docs:build
```
If build errors, screenshot the error and add to the PR.

docs-bot: PR #4321 — docs-preview: success — https://preview.example.com/4321 — checks passed.

docs-bot: PR #4310 — docs-preview: failed — logs: https://ci.example.com/4310/log — status: build error.

Elaine: Sam, saw the failed preview. Can you take a look at the build logs and post the failing file(s)? If it's the CLI snippet we can patch quickly.

Sam: Looking now. It's the example in docs/migration/2026-to-2027.md — outdated flag name. I'll push a quick fix and trigger preview.

Tariq: I've done the link fixes and verified redirects locally. Marked #4342 as ready for review and added the redirect test steps in the PR description.

Elaine: Great. One process note: for any docs that change surface-area (API/flags/examples), let's require two reviewers and a green preview. For small link/text fixes, single reviewer + automated preview OK. We'll call that the temporary rule until translations are sorted.

Lisa: Agreed. Also, if anyone is going to merge during the usual doc merge window (Mon/Tue mornings), please shout in #docs 10m before merging so we avoid overlapping pushes.

Mike: I'll approve my PRs after the preview is green and then wait for Tariq or Lisa to merge.

docs-bot: PR #4310 — docs-preview: success — https://preview.example.com/4310 — checks passed.

Sam: Fixed and pushed. Preview looks good now. PTAL @Lisa @Tariq.

Lisa: Reviewed #4310 — left one nit on wording, otherwise LGTM. I'll wait for Mike's final snippet approvals then merge migration guide after noon to avoid translation window.

Tariq: Reviewed and merged #4342 (link fixes). :white_check_mark:

Elaine: Thanks team — summary: Mike handles snippets, Sam migration, Tariq link fixes; two-reviewer rule for API/code changes, single reviewer OK for tiny fixes. If anyone is blocked by preview flakiness, add the "needs-preview" label and I'll escalate infra.

Mike: Noted. Will post a short checklist template in the PRs for reviewers (preview link, local build command, quick smoke tests).

Elaine: Perfect. If nothing else, we'll re-run this rotation next week to cover gaps. :slightly_smiling_face:
